//: Copy to ~/.config/harness-usage/config.json and edit. Never commit the real file.

postgres.//: rpi5 over Tailscale. Password is the POSTGRES_PASSWORD from server/.env.

claude-code.//billing: 'free' = subscription (Max), 'api' = paid per token. Sets the `billing` column on priced rows.

sync.//staleAfterMinutes: doctor's 'last sync'/'last ship' checks fail past this age. 60 suits an always-on box on a 5-min timer; raise it on a laptop that sleeps.

project.//detectRoot: true = file events under the nearest .git ancestor of the working directory, so subdirectories of one repo collapse into it; false = the working directory itself (pre-plan-008).

//scenarios: Counterfactual targets materialized into Postgres for the dashboard.
Keys are fully-qualified '<provider>/<model>' as they appear in models.json —
note GLM is not on OpenRouter, it comes via gateways like tokengo.
`harness-usage compare --as <key>` works against ANY model in the table,
so this list only needs the ones you want on the dashboard.
Set to [] to skip scenario computation entirely.
